html:
The University of Santo Domingo traces its origin to a papal bull of 1538 that raised the Dominican friars' school in the city to a university, Saint Thomas Aquinas. It claims to be the oldest university in the Americas.

It taught theology, law and medicine to the sons of colonists in the first decades of Spanish rule. Its claim is disputed by the universities of Lima and Mexico, founded by royal decree in 1551.

The university closed in 1823 under the Haitian rule of the island and was refounded in 1914. Today, as the Autonomous University of Santo Domingo, it is the country's largest public university, near the cathedral of the old city.
sum: The University of Santo Domingo traces its origin to a papal bull of 1538 that raised the Dominican friars' school in the city to a university, Saint Thomas Aquinas. It claims to be the oldest university in the Americas.
